capabilities: Upload images, video, audio, PDF and Office files to a configured storage provider
Browse uploaded images in a gallery with lightbox, multi-select and batch actions
Insert links or embeds for uploaded files into notes
Search images by description or visual similarity with a locally run embedding model
Delete remote files and cache local thumbnails
disambiguation: Not just a gallery viewer; its main job is uploading files from notes to external storage providers.
extras: Desktop only and requires Obsidian 1.7.2+. Credentials are stored in plain text in .obsidian/plugins/oss-gallery/data.json. Semantic search is opt-in, needs a hardware GPU with WebGPU (no CPU fallback), and downloads a ~343 MB model from Hugging Face and GitHub with SHA-256 verification. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian keeps attachments inside the vault and offers no way to upload media to external object storage or browse those files in a gallery.

relations.evidence: Upload images, videos, audio and documents from Obsidian to your own storage (S3, R2, MinIO
